A.1 pp. 5-46 is supplied with a complete proof: (a) Keisler's Completeness Theorem and Compactness Theorem for L(Q) over a finite or countable language (Barwise pp. 44-45, used again in 5.6 and in def:p02-w02b-p02-001-lindstrom-limit item 3) are stated only, with thm:p03-keisler-q-one a cited result (owned body 1360-1367); (b) the p. 16 claim that Goedel's second incompleteness theorem yields a truth of Z not following from a given effective true T is proved only under the hypotheses that Prov_{T#} satisfies D2 and D3 and with an informal enumeration of T# (thm:p02-w02c-p02-003-integers-second, owned body 1607-1631, boundary item 3); (c) decidability of the theory of abelian groups and undecidability of the theory of groups (p. 16) are stated without proof (boundary items 1-2); (d) the p. 44 claim about the least logic containing weak second-order logic with explicit definability (Barwise 1974 Thm 4.1) has its proof not written (beyond-boundary item 2). In addition the 5.7 material for general languages and under Barwise 1974 sits in owned files not yet on the route.
